label: Amazon Echo Show 8 (3rd gen) smart display
description: Echo Show 8 (3rd gen, 2023) is an 8-inch Alexa smart display that also acts as a Zigbee hub and Thread border router for Matter. Its only network interface is Wi-Fi 6E (IEEE 802.11ax) at 2.4, 5 or 6 GHz - there is no Ethernet port and no PoE, and the power lead is a USB-C supply rather than a data link.
